verdict.rationale: Jules is explicitly a cloud-hosted agent running in Google-managed VMs (no local infra needed) with GitHub integration, API access, and usage tiers/limits, confirmed by both docs and community usage reports of it running tasks and producing PRs without user-managed backend. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of infrastructure reliability/uptime SLAs and clearer documentation on scaling/parallel task limits beyond the usage-limits table.
